text:
maya: Hey team — quick sync: I did a content pass on Hosted, Dedicated, and Private pages. Can we align headline + one hero stat + single CTA per page? Need a short PRD for the launch post and a benchmark narrative to back claims. :eyes:
kevin: For Hosted hero, try: "Start in minutes. Scale with predictable throughput." Keep it under 10 words. If we can verify latency, add p99 stat (e.g., p99 < 200ms).
sarah: Agree. Also convert feature bullets into benefit-first copy. Example: "Auto batching reduces per-token cost by up to 3x" -> "Lower inference costs by up to 3x with auto-batching."
olivia: For Private page, elevate security and control — lead with VPC/KMS and add a CTA like "Request a security review" instead of generic contact sales. That converts better for SOC2 prospects.
dennis: On inbound routing: Tag form submissions by page type. hosted -> tag=product-trial (SDR nurture), dedicated -> tag=enterprise-eval (AE route), private -> tag=security-review (solutions engineer). Add hidden field deploy_type=hosted|dedicated|private.
maya: Nice. Also want a short webinar hook tied to the benchmark narrative: "How we cut inference costs 3x without sacrificing latency" — use this as the webinar title and the benchmark as the hook in the launch post.
kevin: Draft copy variants (short):
- Hosted hero: "Hosted API — production LLMs without ops"
- Dedicated hero: "Reserved GPU capacity for predictable throughput"
- Private hero: "Private inference behind your VPC"
Pick one per page for A/B testing.
sarah: Microcopy note for pricing: "Pricing shown for reference; contact sales for enterprise SLAs." Keep on all three pages.
olivia: For the benchmark narrative we must list hardware, model version, batch sizes, prompt shapes, and measurement windows. Ops will need to verify. We'll avoid absolute claims until numbers are confirmed.
dennis: I can get ops numbers. I'll ping infra and attach raw CSVs. Expect 48h turnaround.
brand-bot: /reminder maya 2d Prep webinar outline and collect sandbox benchmarks :rocket:
maya: Thanks — I'll update the copy doc with chosen hero variants, the routing hidden fields, and the initial webinar outline. Will add social-ready lines for X/LinkedIn.
kevin: Quick editorial nits: sentence case for bullets, avoid leading gerunds unless it's a CTA. Also prefer active voice.
olivia: Draft social lines for review:
Hosted: "Ship LLM features fast with Redwood's Hosted API — low latency, pay-as-you-go, built for engineers."
Dedicated: "Predictable throughput + SLA-backed plans — Redwood Dedicated for production workloads."
Private: "Keep data in your control. Private deployments with VPC & KMS integrations."
sarah: Add one-liner for webinar promo: "Join our webinar: how to reduce inference costs without trading latency — live benchmark walk-through."
maya: Great. I'll iterate and share final copy before EOD Friday. If anyone has a hard objection to any hero phrasing, flag now.
kevin: :thumbsup:
